title: After months of work, I finally finished my first game: A MEM-Cho fan-game! Looking for feedback!
author: world_waifus
selftext:
Hey guys!

I've been working on this project for a while now and I’m super hyped (and honestly a bit scared) to finally release my first-ever finished game: MEM-Cho: Private Stream Night.

It’s a mix between a Visual Novel and a gambling sim. Basically, you have 3 days to make as much money as you can to spend it on MEM-cho’s "private" streams. She gets pretty wild if you have the cash, lol.

What's in it:

• A bunch of casino games (8 in total: Blackjack, Poker, Slots, etc.)

• A Mem-cho Quiz if you're a real fan and want to win money safely.

• About 52 images to unlock (very intimate stuff).

• A gallery mode and an "auto-play" mode for... well, you know.

I put a lot of effort into making the casino feel real, and I just pushed the 1.02 update to fix some bugs and polish the translation.

Since it’s my first project, I’d really love to get some honest feedback. Does it look like a real game ? Haha

You can try the demo or play the full version here : https://world-waifus.itch.io/memcho-secret-stream

Let me know what you think! Cheers! 🤘

comments.author: Achilleas90
comments.body:
I will be a bit harsh only to help you improve. The menu needs an overhaul. It is bad in terms of ux, I can't see the font good because of the colors and it is bad to navigate. After you press start it asks for a save file. after you choose it just stays there. I was pressing everything fro 2 minutes until I saw that d on the too right. Either auto close the window after you pick a save or don't ask for a save slot at all just save at the next open. some quiz questions were in french although the language I set was English. (Also it has auto selected french, I had to blindly navigate to the options to change that.) Finally in terms of gameplay, it is a good start but it needs a lot of work. The bug hunting is monotonous. The quiz is impossible if you don't know the character.The only thing you gave a lot of care was the casino, although I tried only a couple games. Overall you will need to add a lot more juice to it. Oh, also the game is portrait mode and on html I couldn't turn it whatever I did.
Don't give up. Keep at it and get better. Cheers!

replies.author: world_waifus
replies.body:
Thanks so much for taking the time to write all this down. Honestly, this is exactly the kind of feedback I needed.

When you're the one building it, you end up with "tunnel vision" \^\^' I’ve spent so many hours on the UI that I know it by heart, so I completely missed how confusing it could be for someone discovering it for the first time. Your points about the save window and the navigation are eye-opening. It sounds super clunky now that you describe it, and I'm definitely going to fix that.

You're also right about the juice. I'll admit, adding animations and sound feels like such a mountain of work sometimes that I probably rushed the V1 a bit too much. But your comment really motivated me to put in the polish it deserves. :D

Thanks again for being honest and helping me improve. I’m going to get back to work on this, and I’d love to get your take on the next version when it’s ready. \\o/

comments.author: IAmhowlshot
comments.body: i like where its going, very very good start, def take the constructive criticism and build up on it!

replies.author: world_waifus
replies.body: Thanks a lot! I really appreciate the encouragement. I'm already working on the improvements!

comments.author: AssistBorn4589
comments.body:
I would like to add minor inconvience to what had been said already:

Defaulting to French without any obvious way to change language from main menu is a bad idea. Only my belief that you wouldn't ask for testers for French-only game kept me from giving up and eventually finding the options.

replies.author: world_waifus
replies.body:
Thanks for pointing that out and for not giving up on the game! I'm French, so I build everything in French first and do the translations after. I totally missed how confusing that is for everyone else.

I’m going to add language flags right at the start of the game so it's clear before even hitting the menu. Thanks for the heads up!

comments.author: SeekingSpire
comments.body: Very cool. Curious to know what aspects of the game are AI generated other than the art itself. Did you use agentic AI for coding or any other workflows? Also, is this built in a particular engine? All custom made or did you use any assets? Thanks!

replies.author: world_waifus
replies.body: Thanks! The game is built on Ren'Py, it's super intuitive for the visual novel parts. Since I'm not a coder, I use Gemini to handle all the Python logic. For the visuals, I use a mix of ComfyUI and Photoshop to get the final look I want.
